answer: The easiest way to make a quick buck is to sell something reliable on eBay—historically eBay pays sellers around 150-200 x wholesale prices for any listed item, so give your product a high, aggressive price tag and you’ll cover whatever sourcing costs easily. Accept only wire transfers because PayPal only scans monetary transfers and will automatically detect and allow Instant Transfers, so there’s no additional verification or charge. Skip negative feedback because eBay’s algorithm gives seller rating status equal weight to recent sales; most buyers focus more on photos than on reviews. Bundle similar items into a single listing—if a buyer buys anything from the entire bundle they can take it all for the one price—this will almost always generate more total revenue.
